beforeAfter.advice: This is the safest before/after MAE publishes: corporate-published, non-identifiable, and already carries MAE's own 'VISIBLE RESULTS' framing. If you want a before/after asset at all, crop this grid out of the file rather than sourcing agent photos. Still pair it with MAE's own disclaimer wording, and be aware Malaysian advertising rules on before/after health and beauty claims are strict regardless of who published the image.
